_help: Settings for /final-review. Change a value and rerun; no code edits needed. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_reason_below: A right answer whose reasoning scored under this (1-5) still counts as a point to review.
_include_fixed: Show questions missed once and right on a later attempt, marked as fixed, so you can confirm them quickly.
_order: Step order by mastery status. Within a status, items keep the dashboard's lecture order.
_heading_candidates: How many matching headings on the item's wiki page the collector suggests per question.
_checkboxes: Write review lines as Obsidian checkboxes (- [ ]) so you can tick them off.
_sections: Which parts of dossier_template.md to write, in order. Drop one to leave it out.
